notes.content:

-When you in pve mode you can jump some object and you can finish wave very easily.We fixed this problem.

-Shotgun's damage increased.

-Some words cant readable in menus on the mainmenu.We fixed that problem.

notes.title: Endless Combat Remastered Alpha Version
notes.content:
Hello dear Endless Combat players.Many people complaining about there are no players or empty servers etc.We worked too long time to get this problem fix and we got a solution.We added Pve mode.
Today we released Endless Combat Remastered Alpha version.Lets talk about what is new;

- New Coop Mode Added.About this mode there are 3 difficulty levels.
- New Login System Added.
- New Map Added.
- Exp,Level,Money System Added.
- Ingame Market Added.
- Character System Added.
- New Menus Are Added.
- Optimized Network Subsystem.
- Optimized Graphics.
- Animations Edited.
- Key Bindings Added On Page.

Still not contains P2W materials after long update period.

Before you play if you troubleshooting to login or register etc.You must enable NAT connection or enable DMZ or forward these ports to fix the problem.

*Here is the ports*
-8282 UDP
-8283 UDP
-8284 UDP
-8285 UDP
-8286 UDP

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30693634/47b7234a2e7e436c07a7b0d6b27462f16140b03c.png[/img]

notes.title: About Endless Combat
notes.content:
Hi Folks.I know you guys waited maybe too long but we are working too hard on this game.On this week we will bringing new update to game.Here is the new features;
- New map arrived.(NightClub)
- Zombie mode added.
- In-Game Trader market added.(You can sell your weapon-buy weapon-buy ammo)

Thats all the features.Hope you will like it.

BEST REGARDS.

Fatalitech Indie Game Developer Team...

notes.title: Endless Combat 1.0.0.6 Update Notes
notes.content:
-Fixed punching while reloading bug.
-Fixed punching while weapon switch bug.
-Fixed particle bug on shooting objects.
-Added steam achievement support.Now its working.
-Fixed some characters animation bugs.
-Improved network optimizations.
-Fixed mainmenu fps drops.
-Changed aim distance to standarts.  
-Added in game voice chat. To use "T" key for push to talk.
-Added on settings mute all talkers button and unmute if you click again.
-Fixed chat window and messages.
-Added Windows 32 bit support.

>>>>>> On the future update <<<<<<<
-We will add database support,profile system,ranking,level,money and market system.
-We will add pve mode.
